# speckit workflow render

<!-- generated by `speckit generate commands` -->

Render the four git change-management procedure guides (change-request, finish-change, sync-after-merge, hotfix) from the `[workflow]` config into the configured target directory

## Usage

```text
Usage: speckit workflow render [OPTIONS]
```

`--json` prints one JSON object enabled stdout.

## Help

```text
speckit workflow render --help
```
